findings.title: [P1] Do not persist a complete return before checking the outer deadline
findings.body: When execution and cleanup succeed but the final 750-second check fails, this writes an immutable `parent_return.private.json` with `status='complete'` before raising the deadline error. A subsequent AUDIT accepts that file in both `claim()` and `before_import()`, since neither verifies that BUILD passed its final deadline check. Thus an expired BUILD can still authorize AUDIT despite the caller receiving a failure. Preserve the output inventory first, but determine deadline eligibility before persisting a complete parent return; on expiration, persist an incomplete closure.

overall_explanation: The final parent deadline check can leave a successful, reusable BUILD closure behind after the stage has failed, bypassing the required BUILD-to-AUDIT admission condition. Review was limited to public source inspection; no tests or nested reviewers were run.
